scope.species_context: Human Schwann cells prioritized; other species and states kept distinct

edges.context: Rat sciatic nerve binding context and rat S16 SOX10-loss TSS data

evidence.basis: Pmp22 TSS clusters increase with cAMP and decrease after SOX10 loss in distinct rat culture experiments; 5-prime RNA proxy, indirect effects possible.
EGR2/SOX10 motif perturbations reduce enhancer activity; reporter evidence is not complete endogenous human causality.
Deletion reduces Pmp22 transcription, preferentially P1.

evidence.basis: miR-29a affects endogenous and reporter PMP22 RNA/protein; post-transcriptional mechanism.

evidence.basis: NRG-ErbB2/3-YY1 controls Egr2-AS; chromatin scaffold at Egr2/C-JUN reported. Gene-level RNA result here does not reproduce the simple expected state signature.
